name: End-to-End Tests with Playwright
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        env: [ci, kind, hypershift]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -e .
          pip install pytest playwright
          playwright install

      - name: Run UI Tests
        id: run-ui-tests
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.env }}" = "ci" ]; then
            ./91-run-ui-tests.sh
          elif [ "${{ matrix.env }}" = "kind" ]; then
            # Local Kind testing setup
            echo "Running local Kind tests..."
            # Add Kind-specific setup here
          elif [ "${{ matrix.env }}" = "hypershift" ]; then
            # HyperShift testing setup
            echo "Running HyperShift tests..."
            # Add HyperShift-specific setup here
          fi

      - name: Upload Playwright Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report-${{ matrix.env }}
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Analyze Playwright Results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          artifact: playwright-report-${{ matrix.env }}
          name: Playwright Test Results (${{ matrix.env }})
          path: playwright-report/**/*.xml
          reporter: javascript-jest
          working-directory: .

      - name: Check for Test Failures
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Some tests failed in ${{ matrix.env }} environment"
          exit 1
